zh: 如果我是你，我会先跟老板谈一谈。
old_en: If I were you, I would first talk to the boss.
new_en: If I were you, I'd talk to the boss first.

zh: 如果今天不上班，我会睡到中午。
old_en: If I didn't have to work today, I would sleep until noon.
new_en: If I didn't work today, I'd sleep till noon.

zh: 如果我是老板，我会让大家早点下班。
old_en: If I were the boss, I would let everyone leave early.
new_en: If I were the boss, I'd let everyone leave early.

zh: 如果我不怕高，我会站在最高的地方看看。
old_en: If I weren't afraid of heights, I would stand on the highest place to look around.
new_en: If I weren't scared of heights, I'd stand up high and look around.

zh: 如果能回到十年前，我会多学一门外语。
old_en: If I could go back ten years, I would learn another foreign language.
new_en: If I could go back ten years, I'd learn another language.

zh: 如果我有很多钱，我会去环游世界。
old_en: If I had lots of money, I could travel the world.
new_en: If I had lots of money, I'd travel the world.

zh: 如果我有很多钱，我就买一栋带院子的房子。
old_en: If I had lots of money, I could buy a house with a garden.
new_en: If I had lots of money, I'd buy a house with a yard.

zh: 如果我会开车，我就自己租车去。
old_en: If I could drive, I would rent a car myself.
new_en: If I could drive, I'd rent a car myself.

zh: 如果今天不用上班，我就去看一场电影。
old_en: If I didn't have to work today, I could go see a movie.
new_en: If I didn't have to work today, I'd go see a movie.

zh: 如果我能选，我会住在海边。
old_en: If I could choose, I would live by the sea.
new_en: If I could choose, I'd live by the sea.

zh: 如果我能选，我就选一个安静的地方。
old_en: If I could choose, I would pick a quiet place.
new_en: If I could choose, I'd pick a quiet place.

zh: 如果房子再大一点，我们就养一只狗。
old_en: If the house were bigger, we could get a dog.
new_en: If the house were bigger, we'd get a dog.

zh: 如果房子再大一点，我会专门弄一个书房。
old_en: If the house were bigger, I would set aside a room for a study.
new_en: If the house were bigger, I'd have a study.

zh: 如果我不怕高，我就去试试蹦极。
old_en: If I weren't afraid of heights, I could go try bungee jumping.
new_en: If I weren't scared of heights, I'd try bungee jumping.

zh: 如果我明天不用上班，我会去爬山。
old_en: If I didn't have to work tomorrow, I would go hiking.
new_en: If I didn't work tomorrow, I'd go hiking.

zh: 如果我明天不用上班，我就好好睡一觉。
old_en: If I didn't have to work tomorrow, I could sleep in.
new_en: If I didn't work tomorrow, I'd sleep in.

zh: 如果能回到十年前，我会选一个不同的专业。
old_en: If I could go back to ten years ago, I would choose a different major.
new_en: If I could go back ten years, I'd pick a different major.

zh: 如果我是你，我就不会答应这件事。
old_en: If I were you, I wouldn't agree to it.
new_en: If I were you, I wouldn't agree to it.

zh: 如果我是老板，我就不会开这么多会。
old_en: If I were the boss, I wouldn't hold so many meetings.
new_en: If I were the boss, I wouldn't have so many meetings.

zh: 如果我会开车，上班就不用挤地铁了。
old_en: If I could drive, I wouldn't have to take the crowded subway to work.
new_en: If I could drive, I wouldn't have to take the crowded subway to work.
